0022600186.text: The Miami Heat (2-5) visit the LA Clippers (1-6) as the road team in their eighth game of the season, sitting 10th in the East and 2 games back in the Southeast after a one-game losing streak. The Clippers are 13th in the West, have lost six straight, and are 0-4 on the road, and they are missing Bradley Beal (knee, out), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, out), Jordan Miller (shoulder, out), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, out), while Isaiah Jackson (groin) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. For Miami, Giannis Antetokounmpo (wrist sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Heat won their 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently 140-123 in Miami on December 1, 2025.
